sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total_debt = 0 THEN 'no_debt' WHEN total_debt < 500000000 THEN 'moderate_debt' ELSE 'high_debt' END AS debt_band, CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' ELSE 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE total_debt IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 GROUP BY debt_band, profit_status

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, SUM(CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS profitable_count, AVG(business_segments_num) AS avg_segments FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(the_highest_ownership_stake) AS avg_top_stake FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') AND revenue > 0 GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash, AVG(net_assets) AS avg_net_assets FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL AND net_assets IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(total_assets) AS avg_assets, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') AND total_assets IS NOT NULL AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(the_highest_ownership_stake) AS avg_top_stake FROM finance WHERE the_highest_ownership_stake BETWEEN 5 AND 60 AND principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' ELSE 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND remuneration_policy != '' GROUP BY activity_family, pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN business_segments_num = 1 THEN 'single_segment' WHEN business_segments_num BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'two_or_three' ELSE 'four_or_more' END AS segment_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE business_segments_num IS NOT NULL AND revenue > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment_band

SELECT CASE WHEN the_highest_ownership_stake >= 20 THEN 'concentrated' ELSE 'dispersed' END AS ownership_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE the_highest_ownership_stake IS NOT NULL AND revenue > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ownership_band

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(total_assets) AS avg_assets, MAX(total_assets) AS max_assets, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND total_assets IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, MIN(revenue) AS min_revenue, MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND revenue > 0 AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(earnings_per_share) AS avg_eps, MAX(earnings_per_share) AS max_eps, AVG(dividend_per_share) AS avg_dividend FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND earnings_per_share IS NOT NULL AND dividend_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' ELSE 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt, AVG(cash_reserves) AS avg_cash FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 AND revenue > 0 GROUP BY profit_status

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(dividend_per_share) AS avg_dividend, SUM(CASE WHEN dividend_per_share > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dividend_payers FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND dividend_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, AVG(total_debt) AS avg_debt FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss > 0 AND total_debt IS NOT NULL AND exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, CASE WHEN cash_reserves >= 100000000 THEN 'high_cash' ELSE 'lower_cash' END AS cash_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exchange_family, cash_band

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND exchange_code != '' AND revenue > 0 AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family, exchange_family HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT CASE WHEN business_segments_num = 1 THEN 'single_segment' WHEN business_segments_num BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'two_or_three' WHEN business_segments_num >= 4 THEN 'four_or_more' END AS segment_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment_band

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' ELSE 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 GROUP BY exchange_family, profit_status
